_description: Output contract for pipeline_cards.json — the per-workspace pipeline catalog that drives the SNT Pipelines Orchestrator's active-vs-greyed nodes and its parameter forms. Read this to interpret the file's structure. As of 2026-08-04 the file is NOT part of the repo and NOT part of the deployed webapp bundle: each workspace holds one copy in its own file storage at utils_pipelines/create_pipeline_cards/pipeline_cards/pipeline_cards.json, shared by both UI variants, and both variants fetch it at page load via a signed URL. Pipeline description text is NOT stored here — see app/pipeline_descriptions.json / schemas/pipeline_descriptions.schema.json (one copy, shared across every variant and workspace).
_how_this_file_is_produced: The create_pipeline_cards pipeline generates it — agents do NOT hand-build it. Source lives in this repo at utils_pipelines/create_pipeline_cards/ (see its README.md); it must be deployed to, and run in, each workspace that hosts an orchestrator webapp.

To refresh a workspace's catalog (a pipeline was installed/removed, a parameter changed), re-run that pipeline in the workspace. The webapp picks the new file up on its next page load — no redeploy and no repo commit.

Output location: <workspace files>/utils_pipelines/create_pipeline_cards/pipeline_cards/pipeline_cards.json, per config.OUTPUT_DIR + config.WEBAPP_CARDS_PATH. The webapp's CARDS_OBJECT_KEY constant (in each app/<variant>/app.js) must match this exactly. The previous version is archived to a historical/ subfolder with a timestamp on every run.

Parameters come from each pipeline's deployed current version in that workspace (pipelineByCode.currentVersion.parameters), which is what runPipeline validates against — recorded as parameters_source 'openhexa_deployed'. They are NOT scraped from the snt_development GitHub repo any more, so the catalog cannot drift from the installed version. That version's identity is recorded alongside them as version_name / version_number, so a consumer can tell whether the catalog still matches what is installed now.

Pipeline ids come from regex-matching @pipeline("...") in the deployed pipeline.py. A pipeline with no deployed version, no pipeline.py (e.g. notebook-based), or a malformed decorator gets id null and is excluded when curation runs.

Curation — a pipeline is included iff its `id` is a node of the deployed pipeline_map.json AND it exists live in the workspace. Live pipelines that are not map nodes are excluded (the webapp has no node to render them on); map nodes with no live pipeline are simply absent here and render greyed-out. The pipeline reads pipeline_map.json back from the webapp identified by config.WEBAPP_SLUG (as of 2026-08-04 the Cockpit app, the lead variant), so the DEPLOYED map is the authority — not the repo copy. Curation is not optional: if that webapp is not deployed in the workspace, the run fails rather than emitting an uncurated catalog.
If several workspace pipelines share the same @pipeline id, all are kept and logged as a warning; openhexa_code distinguishes them. Deprecated duplicates should be cleaned up in the workspace.

Historical note: this file used to be generated by an agent (list_pipelines + fetching @parameter decorators from GitHub main) and committed to workspaces/<ws>/<variant>/pipeline_cards.json. That folder was deleted on 2026-08-04. Do not recreate it, and do not add pipeline_cards.json to a webapp bundle.

_type_mapping.str: Dropdown if choices present; text input otherwise.
_type_mapping.str+multiple: Group of checkboxes when choices present; passes an array in the config object.
_type_mapping.DHIS2Connection: Dropdown populated from workspace DHIS2 connections; pass the connection slug.
_type_mapping.CustomConnection: Dropdown populated from workspace custom connections; pass the connection slug.

_schema.generated_at: string — ISO date when this file was generated (YYYY-MM-DD)

pipelines.id: string — Python function name; stable key across workspaces
pipelines.name: string — human-readable display name for the UI card header
pipelines.uuid: string — workspace-specific pipeline UUID; NEVER copy across workspaces
pipelines.openhexa_code: string — OpenHEXA pipeline code/slug; useful when multiple instances of the same pipeline exist in one workspace
pipelines.parameters_source: string — always 'openhexa_deployed' in files produced by create_pipeline_cards: parameters were read from the pipeline's deployed version via the OpenHEXA API, which is what runPipeline validates against. Legacy values still accepted when reading old files: 'github_main' (scraped from the snt_development main branch — the pre-2026-08-04 agent-generated path) and 'unavailable' (that scrape 404'd, so parameters is empty)
pipelines.version_name: string — versionName of the deployed pipeline version these parameters were read from; this is the label the OpenHEXA UI shows for it. Null if the pipeline has no deployed version. Present since 2026-08-04; absent in files generated before that.
pipelines.version_number: integer — versionNumber of that same deployed version. Monotonic, so this is the field to compare against the live pipeline to detect that the catalog has fallen behind (the pipeline's parameters may have changed since). Null if the pipeline has no deployed version. Present since 2026-08-04; absent in files generated before that.

parameters.key: string — parameter key matching the @parameter decorator; used verbatim in the config object
parameters.label: string — display label
parameters.type: string — bool | int | float | str | DHIS2Connection | CustomConnection | File
parameters.multiple: boolean — omit if false; when true and type is str, the config value is an array
